nonBlockingImprovements.title: run-report.js does not re-export buildUpgradeEvidenceReportSummary, failing the spec-local R9 test
nonBlockingImprovements.issue: run-report.js imports buildUpgradeEvidenceReportSummary from test-artifacts.js for internal use (line 23/57) but does not re-export it. The spec-local test specs/278-upgrade-evidence-artifact/tests/upgrade-evidence-artifacts.test.js (R9) resolves the symbol from run-report.js via loadReportModule(), so the destructured binding is undefined and the test fails with 'buildUpgradeEvidenceReportSummary is not a function'. Running `node --test` on the file yields 10 pass / 1 fail. Production report generation itself is correct; only the test wiring is broken.
nonBlockingImprovements.suggestion: Add `export { buildUpgradeEvidenceReportSummary } from "./test-artifacts.js";` to run-report.js (or otherwise re-export it) so the R9 spec-local test resolves the function from the module it imports from. Alternatively the test could import it from test-artifacts.js, but that test file is outside the touched set; re-exporting from run-report.js is the touched-file fix.
nonBlockingImprovements.rationale: R9's acceptance criterion ('a test can assert report.json includes the upgradeEvidence summary fields') is backed by a test that currently fails due to an import-resolution mismatch, not a production defect. Re-exporting makes the green test reflect the working production behavior.

blockingFindings.title: Integration gate can use stale changed_files and skip required upgrade evidence
blockingFindings.issue: validateIntegrationArtifactTrust decides whether upgrade evidence is required from result.regression.changed_files in test-execute-result.json. For regression.required=false artifacts, assertIntegrationRegressionEvidence does not recompute or compare the current git changed file list, so a skill or preset change made after test-execute can reach integration gate with a stale artifact that does not mention src/skills/** or src/presets/** and no upgrade-result.json will be required.
blockingFindings.suggestion: In validateIntegrationArtifactTrust, derive the upgrade-evidence trigger from the current gate changed file list, for example by calling listRegressionChangedFiles({ root, state }) or by accepting the gate's current changed files as an argument, and pass that list to validateUpgradeEvidenceForChangedFiles. Keep the artifact snapshot validation separate so stale test-execute data cannot suppress R4.
blockingFindings.rationale: R4 requires the integration gate itself to require upgrade evidence when the changed file list contains src/skills/** or src/presets/**. Basing the decision only on a persisted test artifact allows the gate to PASS without the required evidence after relevant files change.

blockingFindings.title: Preset deployment updates are not reflected in upgrade-result result
blockingFindings.issue: UpgradeEvidenceRecorder.write computes result=updated only from skillResults, removedSkills, and configChanged. deployPresetCopies(root, ...) is executed but its returned paths are ignored, so a run that updates preset-derived files can still write result=no_changes when no skills or config migrations changed.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Track deployPresetCopies in main, make the preset deployment branch report whether it changed outputs, and include that preset update signal in the result calculation passed to UpgradeEvidenceRecorder.write.
blockingFindings.rationale: R2 says no_changes is used only when exitCode is 0 and no skill removal, skill update, preset/config migration, or other tracked update occurred. Ignoring preset deployment changes makes the machine-readable evidence contradict the actual upgrade outcome.

blockingFindings.title: Preset-only upgrade evidence fails its own validator
blockingFindings.issue: UpgradeEvidenceRecorder.write can emit result="updated" when only preset deployment changed, but UpgradeResultArtifact validates tracked changes using only skills.updated, skills.removed, and configMigration.changed. A preset-only update therefore writes an artifact with result="updated" and no validator-visible tracked change, causing validateUpgradeEvidenceFiles to reject the required upgrade evidence.
blockingFindings.suggestion: Add a preset deployment field to upgrade-result.json, for example presetDeployment.changed, populate it in UpgradeEvidenceRecorder.write from presetChanged, and include that field in UpgradeResultArtifact validation's hasTrackedChanges calculation. Alternatively record preset updates as an explicit updated artifact list and validate against that field.
blockingFindings.rationale: R2 requires preset updates to be reflected in the machine-readable upgrade result. The current writer and validator disagree on whether preset changes are tracked, so valid preset-only upgrade runs become unusable evidence at the integration gate.
